title: The Country Mile
description: Travel a country mile from village outskirts through fields, a working farm, a river bridge and a distant rolling lane. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

rooms.name: The village outskirts
rooms.lesson: Pass the last village fences. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

rooms.name: The long fields
rooms.lesson: The fields break around drainage ditches. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

rooms.name: The working farm
rooms.lesson: Thread the farm’s loading sheds. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

rooms.name: The country river crossing
rooms.lesson: Use the travelling bridge before the final lane. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

rooms.name: The distant rolling lane
rooms.lesson: Follow the country mile over its last hill. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.
